test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

About 200 birds were driven out of their habitats by the City Council based on a Health Department recommendation.

options.text: A Health Department recommendation was the basis for the City Council to drive out 200 birds from their habitats.
The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation.
About 200 birds is driven out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.
The City Council has driven about 200 birds out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The active voice converts the subject performing the action (here, the City Council) to the subject of the sentence.
 
• The original passive voice sentence indicates the action performed on the birds by the City Council.
 
• The structure should align with the past tense used in the original passive sentence ("**were driven**").
 
• "**About 200 birds**" becomes the object in the active voice sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is '**The City Council drove about 200 birds out of their habitats, based on a Health Department recommendation**'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A Health Department recommendation was the basis for the City Council to drive out 200 birds from their habitats.**

 
 
• This option is incorrect because, although it provides context, it does not present the sentence in the active voice form directly mentioning the subject (City Council) performing the action.
 
 
 
• **About 200 birds is driven out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because "is driven" is incorrectly used instead of the past tense form and it does not successfully convert the sentence to the active voice.
 
 
 
• **The City Council has driven about 200 birds out of their habitats based on a Health Department recommendation.**
 
 
• This option is incorrect because it uses present perfect tense ("has driven") instead of the past tense used in the original sentence.
